intent: Stack an item's title and description in the column that takes the row's free width.
typical_uses: The title and description column of an Item

dont_use_when.situation: The body of a bounded panel

invariants.text: ItemContent is a flex column spaced var(--space-1) apart that grows into the row's free width and has no minimum width, so a long title or description is cut by its own truncation instead of widening the row. An ItemContent that directly follows another ItemContent does not grow; it keeps its content's width.

anti_patterns.dont: Place two ItemContent blocks in a row expecting two equal columns
anti_patterns.do_instead: Use one ItemContent for the main text and a second one only for a short trailing block, such as a timestamp, which keeps its own width

good.title: A main column and a trailing timestamp

bad.title: Title and description placed straight in the row
bad.why: The row is a wrapping flex row, so the two text parts sit side by side instead of stacked, and neither takes the free width; wrap them in ItemContent.
